models.label: NVIDIA original

models.label: Balance-1 (40 min training)
models.about: First balance training of NVIDIA's SOMA tracker in a tilting box (The Box, train/balance1.py, 40 min on an RTX 4090). Steps instead of stiffening; still walks downhill under steady tilts. Derived from NVIDIA's model (NVIDIA Open Model License, body/soma_tracker_LICENSE.pdf).

models.label: Relaxed standing (01:48, best so far)
models.about: relax-1 checkpoint of 06:48 UTC (MuJoCo training with the game physics), read as hinge angles (meta.direct, v15.26): steadiest in tools/test/idle_test.mjs (feet 5.8/8.4 cm/s on the two idle clips). Derived from NVIDIA's model (NVIDIA Open Model License).

models.label: Live training (relax1, saved 02:28)
models.about: The newest checkpoint of the training that is running now (updated every ~10 min). Derived from NVIDIA's model (NVIDIA Open Model License).
